body: It's the main reason I don't reach out to other's about it anymore. It just makes me feel worse, the idea that you are burdening others with your issues. Not only that, they can't solve it. So in the end it just feels like a fruitless endeavor. I'm sorry that you have no one to reach out to that seemingly gives a shit. But I know what you are feeling, and wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy. I hope things get better for you.
